gaps.title: Multi-standard export compliance across 10 facilities is a heavy manual burden
gaps.detail: Operations run under ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, HACCP, Codex Alimentarius, OIE guidelines, and Halal compliance simultaneously, across ten facilities. Each additional standard and each importing country's inspection requirements multiplies the audit-trail burden -- a unified, automated compliance and deviation-reporting layer would replace per-facility manual recordkeeping with one consistent, exportable record.
gaps.based_on: Operations are ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and HACCP process-compliant, following Codex Alimentarius standards and OIE guidelines, with meat exports prepared to Halal requirements.

gaps.title: Large multi-facility cold storage network without a stated unified visibility layer
gaps.detail: 66,000 MTS of cold storage spread across ten facilities, feeding 750,000 MTS of annual throughput to 70+ export markets, is a lot of inventory and temperature-zone complexity to coordinate site by site. Each export market likely carries its own cold-chain documentation expectations, which compounds the case for one real-time operational view across every facility rather than ten separate ones.
gaps.based_on: Frigorifico Allana's frozen meat operations have an annual production capacity of 750,000 MTS and cold storage capacity of 66,000 MTS spread across ten facilities, exporting to over 70 countries.

pitch.angle: Frigorifico Allana runs meat exports at a scale most competitors can't match -- 750,000 MTS a year, 66,000 MTS of cold storage across 10 facilities, shipped to 70+ countries under ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, HACCP, Codex Alimentarius, OIE, and Halal compliance simultaneously. That's not one audit to pass -- it's potentially dozens running in parallel across every facility and every export market. GND's ThinxFresh turns that into one real-time, auto-generated compliance record per facility instead of a scramble every time a new country's import inspector shows up.
pitch.opener: With 66,000 MTS of cold storage across 10 facilities feeding 70+ export markets, how are you currently proving compliance with ISO, HACCP, and OIE standards to each importing country's inspectors -- one system, or one scramble per audit?
